MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.2.3 (npm package @mediapipe/tasks-vision), the Face Landmarker model
(face_landmarker.task, float16 v1) and the Selfie Multiclass segmenter (selfie_multiclass_256x256.tflite,
float32), both from storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models.
Copyright The MediaPipe Authors. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt).

Dial uses them only for "Protect skin": finding the exact outline of each face, and the skin of the neck,
ears, arms and hands, inside the box you drag.
Everything runs on your device and the files are loaded only when you press Protect skin.

Changed by Dial (18 Nov 2026): in vision_bundle.mjs the usage-metrics logger's flush() returns at once,
so MediaPipe never sends its usage numbers to Google. Nothing else is changed. Only the files Dial needs
are kept (the browser bundle, one wasm build and its loader, and the model).
